source:
Sweet Lord Jesus on the cross, 

I’d like to offer today’s prayer to Romina. She came into the gas station drunk, again, and loafed around while arguing with them voices in her head. Smelled like somethin' awful in her ratty coat. It took all my strength to remain polite and firm even though she was cussin’ and throwin’ an imaginary fit in front of customers. Shameful! I gave her a free cup of coffee to get her to leave. 

But boy, how I wanted to slap some sense into her, tell her to git like a mangy cat. I had these terrible thoughts of, ya know, wantin' her to, I suppose, join you in heaven… peacefully of course. She's in pain. Everyone knows she chose drugs over salvation and that’s why she’s lost. But I realize I gotta pray and hope and remember the story from the Book of Mark where Jesus touches and heals the lepers. 

Though… even the lepers had the respect to live away from the normal townsfolk. Romina doesn’t seem to care about anyone but herself. Plain selfish. Why won’t she pull herself out of the bottle? Why put problems on other people? We all got our own! Doesn’t she have even a pea-size sense of decency? Lord help me, she really does boil my goose!
target:
十字架上慈爱的主耶稣啊：

我今天想为萝蜜娜祷告。她又醉醺醺地走进加油站，在里头晃来晃去，跟脑子里那些声音吵架。她穿着那件破外套，身上的气味难闻得很。她在客人面前满嘴脏话，对着不存在的东西大发脾气，我可是使尽了力气，才忍住没失礼，坚持请她离开。真丢人！我送了她一杯咖啡，才把她打发走。

可是啊，我多想一巴掌把她打醒，像赶癞皮猫那样叫她滚。我竟然起了这种可怕的念头：就是……希望她干脆去天堂陪您算了……当然，是平平安安地去。她这么痛苦。大家都知道，她选了毒品，没选救赎，才会迷失成这样。不过我明白，我得祷告、得抱着希望，得记住《马可福音》里，耶稣伸手触摸并医好痲疯病人的故事。

可是……就连痲疯病人都懂得体谅别人，住得离正常镇民远远的。萝蜜娜好像除了自己，谁也不在乎。自私透顶。她为什么不能自己走出酒瓶？为什么要把麻烦丢给别人？我们每个人都有自己的麻烦！她连一丁点做人的分寸都没有吗？主啊，求您帮帮我，她真的快把我气炸了！

source:
I called in a civilian assistance request 12 hours after Everly Praetis was reported missing. Bill Steely’s bloodhound found her remains. Location of crime scene is Pine Hills Park, coordinates 36.6831° N, 83.8218° W. 

Head is dismembered… body is next to it. Appears victim was executed via beheading on an old grave (Sadie Sloane’s) and died immediately. 

Standard 28-inch splitting axe, blood on the blade. Initial investigation reveals no sign of struggle from victim. No dirt, skin, or hair under fingernails… lipstick, earrings, and make-up is in-tact on the head, save for dirt and leaves. Clothing appears unmolested. Nothing missing from victim’s wallet. Phone and pendant necklace with victim’s face found in coat pocket. 

Two pairs of shoe tracks lead to execution site. Both approximately same size and tread…  identical to the victim’s shoes. Tracks disappear at location of homicide. Bloodhound did not pick up further scents to follow from there. 

(Assisting Officer Walrod vomited near the crime scene. Sent him off to get a grip and some coffee for incoming investigators.)
target:
艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯通报失踪十二小时后，我请求民间协助。比尔・史蒂利的寻血猎犬找到她的遗体。犯罪现场位于松丘公园，座标北纬 36.6831°、西经 83.8218°。

头部遭斩断……身体就在旁边。看来死者在一座老坟（莎蒂・斯隆的坟墓）上被斩首处决，当场死亡。

一般二十八吋劈木斧，斧刃带血。初步调查未见死者挣扎迹象。指甲下没有泥土、皮肤或毛发……断首上的口红、耳环与妆容完整，只有些泥土和落叶。衣物似未遭拉扯。皮夹内无物品遗失。手机与刻有死者肖像的坠炼，于外套口袋内寻获。

两组鞋印通往处决现场。尺寸与鞋底纹路大致相同……与死者的鞋完全一致。鞋印在命案发生处消失。寻血猎犬未能从该处嗅出其他可追踪气味。

（协助办案的沃尔罗德警员在现场附近呕吐。已叫他离开，冷静一下，并为即将抵达的调查员带咖啡。）

source: This build includes many Quality of Life (QoL) improvements and minor bug resolutions. Completed era icons, and game completion popups are the primary additions in this build. Finally, the story was tested and corrected for general flow (we are seeking to optimize a sequential narrative, with non-linear gameplay). Changes - Story flow optimized. - Created final timeline era icons. - Game Completion Tiers & Popups implemented. - Resolved an issue where newly unlocked characters would briefly reveal all of their stories. - Implemented some mood enhancements to the game's final story. - Fix an issue with completed nature locations being incorrectly counted. - Fix an issue with unlocked plants and animals being incorrectly counted. - Added a thicker vertical scroll bar to the people page. - Correctly sized & aligned the people page. - Fixed an issue where grow-up characters could grow up into the wrong row. - Fixed some cards that had an erroneous lock-out message.
target: 这个版本包含许多便利性改善与小型错误修正，主要新增完成版的时代图示及游戏完成提示视窗。此外，我们也测试并调整了故事的整体衔接；我们希望在非线性玩法中，呈现顺畅的依序叙事。 变更 - 改善故事衔接。 - 制作完成版的时间轴时代图示。 - 实作游戏完成度阶段与提示视窗。 - 修正新解锁角色会短暂显示其所有故事的问题。 - 加强游戏最后一篇故事的氛围。 - 修正已完成自然地点计数错误的问题。 - 修正已解锁植物与动物计数错误的问题。 - 为人物页面加入更粗的垂直卷轴。 - 修正人物页面的尺寸与对齐。 - 修正成长角色可能移至错误列的问题。 - 修正部分卡片显示错误锁定讯息的问题。

Moderator Deborah Wolf, Secretary Wendy Greeves and the usual three officers from the Mayor’s police force were present and armed. Deborah wished everyone a happy new year, introduced special guest Peter Swack (former owner of Swack Plumbing), and laid out the agenda: 

* Moment of silence for Jillian A. Benton and Hector P. Benton, elderly neighbors found frozen to death in their home. Funeral set for next Sunday.  

-Request for substitute teacher volunteers for grades kindergarten, 4, 6, and 9 (in case of seasonal illness)

-Roof of Doug Fennison’s home collapsed from heavy snow, volunteers needed to house a family of 4 until permanent solution

- Discuss proposal to Mayor to increase rations

- Discuss proposal to Mayor to allow firewood gathering from Pine Hills Park

- Discuss building outhouses as sewage systems start to fail

- Peter Swack to share methods for preventing freezing of pipes in buildings/home

source: We’re continuing to address a wide range of issues raised by the community. The added fast forward buttons will provide players with the option to skip ahead in time. These buttons make the game more accessible to a variety of play styles, however, we view the idle (causal / cozy) wait periods as part of the core game experience we are seeking to develop, and therefore, we have defaulted these buttons to off. But feel free to to play any way that you enjoy the most! Changes - Added 4 hr, 8 hr, and 12 hr fast-forward buttons. These are not enabled by default, and must be enabled in the settings menu. - Steam achievements will be reprocessed upon loading of games. - Added the ability to re-display 100% completion popups from the victory page. - Added a tooltip displaying the amount of EXP (or other resource) required to obtain future stories on the people, plants, and animals pages. @LightSol - Era hotkey glyphs no longer displayed when in Steam Deck mode.
target: 我们持续处理社群提出的各种问题。 新增的快转按钮，让玩家可以选择跳过一段时间。这些按钮能配合更多不同的游玩方式，不过我们认为，放置等待带来的休闲与舒适感，是我们想打造的核心体验之一，因此预设关闭这些按钮。无论如何，请尽情用你最喜欢的方式游玩！ 变更 - 新增快转 4、8、12 小时的按钮。这些按钮预设关闭，必须在设定选单中启用。 - 载入存档时，会重新处理 Steam 成就。 - 现在可以从完成度页面重新显示 100% 完成提示视窗。 - 在人物、植物与动物页面加入提示，显示取得后续故事所需的经验值或其他资源数量。@LightSol - Steam Deck 模式不再显示时代快捷键符号。

source:
My favorite memory is from last year during the fall harvist festivul because there was so much good food and games. There was apple and oat bars, hunny pepper deer jerky (my favarite) and a bunch of contests like the sack race and egg toss. It’s the only time of year where everyone shares there things and is happy and the town smells AMAZING. 

My best friend Jill and me came in 3rd place during the three legged race (because we practiced all during spring). Our prize was a bag of maple seerup cookies which we ate in probably 2 seckonds. We actually beat two black dog soldiers who fell over during the race! 

Then at night some people got out instramints like a gitar, a pipe, and a harmonika and they made music. The old folks new a bunch of dances so we just watched them and tried to copy their feet. 

Imagine if the fall festivul could happen all the time. If I was the leader in town I would make every day like this. Why can’t we do it now?
target:
我最喜欢的回忆，是去年秋天的丰收节，因为有好多好吃的东西和游戏。有苹果燕麦棒、蜂蜜胡椒鹿肉干（我的最爱），还有好多比赛，像套袋赛跑和丢鸡蛋。这是一年当中唯一大家都会分享东西、都很开心的时候，整个镇闻起来香得不得了。

我和最好的朋友吉儿，在两人三脚比赛拿了第三名，因为我们整个春天都在练习。奖品是一袋枫糖饼干，我们大概两秒就吃光了。我们还打败了两个黑犬士兵，他们比赛时摔倒了！

到了晚上，有人拿出吉他、笛子和口琴之类的乐器，开始演奏。老人家会跳好多种舞，我们就看着他们，试着学他们的脚步。

想像一下，要是一直都能过丰收节就好了。如果我是镇上的首领，我会让每天都像这样。为什么我们现在不能这么做？

source: I gotta get a handle on Romina. Maybe come down hard on these social workers that keep shruggin’ her off. Her schizophrenic meltdowns are raising hell, damaging property all of a sudden, and it feels like only a matter of time until she hurts someone… I jailed her for the night – maybe the third time in a month? She was smashin' beer bottles on the stop sign near the Praetis’ house. Yelling about beelzebub and demons and “a reckoning to the one-eyed angel.” Poor Everly Praetis... her voice shakin' on the phone. Romina's gonna sleep off the booze and start hollerin’ apocalypse at sunup. As usual, she's out at dawn and running off into Pine Hills Park, God knows where. The town is riding my hide about getting her off the streets... permanently. She's a townie though – one of us Asbury people for decades now. What do we got if we don't take care of our own? But she's never been this bad...
target: 我得想办法管住萝蜜娜。也许该对那些老把她推开的社工强硬一点。她的思觉失调一发作就闹得天翻地覆，最近还突然开始砸东西，感觉伤到人只是早晚的事…… 我把她关了一晚——这个月大概第三次了吧？她在普雷蒂斯家附近，朝停车标志砸啤酒瓶，嘴里喊着别西卜、恶魔，还有「独眼天使的清算」。可怜的艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯……打电话来时，声音都在抖。萝蜜娜睡醒酒退，太阳一出来又要大喊世界末日。照惯例，她天亮就出去，跑进松丘公园，天知道去了哪里。镇民一直逼我把她从街上弄走……永远弄走。 可她是镇上的人啊——几十年来，都是我们阿斯伯里的一分子。如果连自己人都不照顾，我们还剩什么？但她以前从没这么严重……

source: Welcome to our public early access demo! This demo allows players to traverse the initial portion of our narrative, representing approximately 10% of the full game narrative. Additionally, the demo exposes the player to most of the game's primary progression avenues, but does not allow access to science, religion, and government. We hope you enjoy and wishlist our game! As part of the game development process, we do hope to get as much feedback as possible from this demo. So please leave any comments you have in our discord! Changes - Implemented next segment of gameplay, flow, and content for use within the purpose of the demo. - Setup mechanism to limit timeline progress within the demo. - New characters added to the present are now usable in present locations. - Adjusted progression speed for initial characters in segment 2. - Added demo complete story \ popup.
target: 欢迎体验公开抢先试玩版！这个试玩版让玩家走过故事的初始部分，约占完整游戏叙事的 10%。此外，玩家也能体验大部分主要成长途径，但无法使用科学、宗教与政体。我们希望你玩得开心，也请将游戏加入愿望清单！ 在开发过程中，我们希望透过试玩版取得尽可能多的回馈，欢迎到我们的 Discord 留下任何意见！ 变更 - 为试玩版实作下一段的玩法、流程与内容。 - 设定限制试玩版时间轴进度的机制。 - 新加入现代的角色，现在可在现代地点使用。 - 调整第二阶段初始角色的成长速度。 - 新增试玩完成故事与提示视窗。

source:
For the second day, local authorities actively search for missing girl Sadie Sloan: age nine, red-blonde hair, green eyes, last wearing a navy blue dress, and last seen near pine woods due north of town hall. Only a white bow has been found. Daughter of Mr. Finn and Mrs. Bernadette Sloan. Mr. Sloan is offering a reward of five hundred dollars for any information that leads to the location of his missing daughter. 

Volunteer search parties and opportunistic trackers have arrived in droves from neighboring counties. 

Mr.  Sloan provided beif commentary, alleging that the cabaret and morally harmful outlets in town would likely promote such sickening crime. He asks for prayers and God’s mercy.  

Contact Senior Constable Theodore Heller with any information that may aid in finding or establish the whereabouts of Sadie Sloan.
target:
地方当局积极搜寻失踪女孩莎蒂・斯隆，今日已进入第二天。女孩九岁，红金色头发、绿眼睛，最后穿着深蓝色洋装，最后被目击于镇公所正北方的松林附近。目前仅寻获一个白色蝴蝶结。她是芬恩・斯隆先生与柏娜黛特・斯隆夫人的女儿。斯隆先生悬赏五百美元，征求任何能找出失踪女儿下落的线索。

志愿搜救队与希望借此获利的追踪者，已从邻近各郡大批赶来。

斯隆先生简短表示，镇上的歌舞表演酒馆及其他败坏道德的场所，很可能助长了这种令人作呕的犯罪。他请求大家祈祷，并祈求上帝怜悯。

如有任何能协助寻获或确认莎蒂・斯隆下落的资讯，请联络资深警员西奥多・赫勒。

source: Sheriff Aldous T. Snow has appointed his son, Rodney “Buzz” Snow, to serve as Deputy Sheriff to the county of Asbury Pines. From local courts and businesses to community and spiritual leaders, there is near-unanimous approval to deputize Buzz. The town has high hopes for the young officer, though a wink of skepticism remains as to whether the son of “The Warhorse” will live up to his father’s venerable legacy.
